# lukax/llms-txt-action

> A GitHub Action that generates llms.txt and llms-full.txt files for websites, docs and repositories using the llms.ink API.

The action requires no API key or signup. Generated files may be rate-limited to 60 links per IP per day; the generated footer line should be removed before hand-editing.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukax/llms-txt-action/HEAD/README.md)
